name: ZX_TRANSACTION_LINES
description: This table stores Transaction Lines info

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the application event class for the transaction

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Column to store type of the transaction line. Possible values are ITEM, FREIGHT and MISC.

columns.name: TRX_BUSINESS_CATEGORY
columns.description: Transaction business category code of the transaction line

columns.name: LINE_INTENDED_USE
columns.description: Intended use code of the transaction line. This identifies the purpose for which the product is used.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISC_CLASS
columns.description: User defined fiscal classification code of the transaction line

columns.name: LINE_AMT_INCLUDES_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether any tax is included in the transaction line amount and unit price. Possible values are A, N, S and I.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit Price of the transaction line item or product

columns.name: PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Column to store internal identifier of the inventory item or memo line used on this transaction line.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FISC_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Product fiscal classification code of the inventory item

columns.name: PRODUCT_ORG_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the organization for the inventory item

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure code for the inventory item

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.description: Product type code of the inventory item. Possible values are GOODS and SERVICES.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Product category code of the transaction line

columns.name: MERCHANT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Merchant party identifier recorded for the Payables expense report

columns.name: ACCOUNT_STRING
columns.description: Column to store concatanated account string value

columns.name: REF_DOC_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier for the reference document

columns.name: APPLIED_FROM_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier for the applied from document

columns.name: APPLIED_FROM_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Applied from document event class code

columns.name: ADJUSTED_DOC_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier for the adjusted document

columns.name: PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the inventory item or memo line used on the transaction line

columns.name: TRX_LINE_GL_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date for the transaction line

columns.name: LINE_LEVEL_ACTION
columns.description: Column to store action at the transaction line level

columns.name: HISTORICAL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N represents whether the document or invoice has been upgraded from a prior release or whether it has been newly created.

columns.name: LINE_CLASS
columns.description: Column to store event class for the transaction line

columns.name: TRX_SHIPPING_DATE
columns.description: Shipping date of the transaction at header or line level

columns.name: TRX_RECEIPT_DATE
columns.description: Receipt date of the transaction at header or line level

columns.name: POA_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Point of acceptance party site identifier

columns.name: POO_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Point of origin party site identifier

columns.name: APPLIED_TO_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Applied to document event class code

columns.name: APPLIED_TO_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier for the applied to document

columns.name: CTRL_HDR_TX_APPL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the control amount for the total tax amount is available at the header level

columns.name: CTRL_TOTAL_LINE_TX_AMT
columns.description: Control amount for the total tax amount at the line level

columns.name: INPUT_TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax classifiation code for Procure To Pay products

columns.name: OUTPUT_TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax classifiation code for Order To Cash products

columns.name: REF_DOC_TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the reference document line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: APPLIED_TO_TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the applied to document line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: APPLIED_FROM_TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the applied from document line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_DOC_TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the adjusted document line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: EXEMPTION_CONTROL_FLAG
columns.description: Lookup code to control the application of exemptions to the transaction line during tax lines calculation. Possible values are R, S and E.

columns.name: RECEIVABLES_TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type identifier for Receivables transactions

columns.name: RECEIVABLES_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Transaction type identifier for Receivables transactions

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: INTENDED_USE_CLASSIF_ID
columns.description: Default intended use code for transactions for a specified country.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the source document line identifier is stored.

columns.name: BILL_THIRD_PTY_ACCT_SITE_ID
columns.description: Third Party Billing Account Site Identifier

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUST_ACCT_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Third Party Billing Account  Site Usage Identifier

columns.name: SHIP_THIRD_PTY_ACCT_SITE_ID
columns.description: Third Party Shipping Account Site Identifier

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUST_ACCT_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Third Party Shipping Account Site Use Identifier

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the tax invoice used to meet specific tax reporting requirements of different countries.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Date of the tax invoice used to meet specific tax reporting requirements of different countries.

columns.name: WHT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Withholding group identifier for the transaction line.

columns.name: REQUISITION_TYPE
columns.description: Requisition type associated a transaction line.

columns.name: PURCHASING_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Item category identifier for a transaction line.

columns.name: DROP_SHIP_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether a transaction line is a drop ship transaction.

columns.name: CONSIGNED_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether a transaction line is consigned.

columns.name: DESTINATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Destination type code for a good or service on a transaction line.

columns.name: CONSIGN_ITM_UPON_RECPT_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates a consigned item upon receipt.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_TYPE
columns.description: Project expenditure type used to build accounting flexfield for project-related distribution line.

columns.name: PORT_OF_DISCHARGE
columns.description: Location code where a ship voluntarily and without cause of necessity breaks bulk and discharges part or all of its cargo.

columns.name: PORT_OF_LOADING
columns.description: Location code where shipments are loaded and secured aboard a vessel.

columns.name: DELIVERY_TYPE
columns.description: Delivery type for a good or service on a transaction line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Document type for a good or service on a transaction line.

columns.name: SHIPMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Shipment type associated with a transaction line.

columns.name: FOS_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Supply chain financial orchestration agreement identifier.

columns.name: FINAL_DISCHARGE_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Final destination location identifier for the purchases made by the customer.

columns.name: COUNTRY_OF_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.description: Code for the country of the manufacture

columns.name: FINAL_TRANSACTION_NODE_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether the internal material transfer is backed by an invoice.

columns.name: CREDIT_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Credit account identifier for the transaction line.

columns.name: DEBIT_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Debit account identifier for the transaction line.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: LOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request status of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: LINK_TO_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Item line identifier associated with a charge line.

columns.name: PACKING_CHARGE
columns.description: Amount of the packing charge on a transaction.

columns.name: PURCHASE_BASIS
columns.description: Monetary value basis of the line type.

columns.name: ACCRUE_ON_RECEIPT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the underlying procure-to-pay transaction allows accrual on receipt. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: LINE_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifer to group multiple transaction lines together, such as grouping mutiple shipment lines as one fulfillment line.

columns.name: TRX_APPL_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Application short name of the transaction.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_PTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Party number used for shipping merchandise.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_PTY_NAME
columns.description: Party name used for shipping merchandise.

columns.name: SHIP_FROM_PTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Party number from whom goods are shipped.

columns.name: SHIP_FROM_PTY_NAME
columns.description: Party name from whom goods are shipped.

columns.name: BILL_TO_PTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Party number that is responsible for receiving and paying the invoice.

columns.name: BILL_TO_PTY_NAME
columns.description: Party name that is responsible for receiving and paying the invoice.

columns.name: BILL_FROM_PTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Party number that is responsible for sending the invoice.

columns.name: BILL_FROM_PTY_NAME
columns.description: Party name that is responsible for sending the invoice.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_LOCATION_NAME
columns.description: Location for the place where goods are received from a vendor.

columns.name: SHIP_FRM_PTY_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Code for the party site from where goods are shipped.

columns.name: BILL_TO_LOCATION_NAME
columns.description: Location for the customer that is responsible for receiving and paying the invoice.

columns.name: BILL_FRM_PTY_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Code for the party site that is responsible for sending the invoice.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Batch name to be used in conjunction with transaction number to identify the parent transaction.

columns.name: DEBIT_ACCT_STRING
columns.description: Concatenated accounting flexfield segments associated with the debit account.

columns.name: CREDIT_ACCT_STRING
columns.description: Concatenated accounting flexfield segments associated with the credit account.

columns.name: ADJ_DOC_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier of a line on the adjusted document.

columns.name: ADJ_DOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number of the adjusted document.

columns.name: ADJ_DOC_APP_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Application short name of the adjusted document.

columns.name: APP_FRM_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier of a line on the applied from document.

columns.name: APP_FRM_DOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number of the applied from document.

columns.name: APP_FRM_APPL_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Application short name of the applied from document.

columns.name: REF_DOC_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier of a line on the reference document associated with the transaction.

columns.name: REF_DOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number of the reference document associated with the transaction.

columns.name: REF_DOC_APPL_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Application short name of the reference document associated with the transaction.

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_NUM
columns.description: First party tax registration number of the transaction.

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: First party tax registration ID of the transaction.

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_REG_NUM
columns.description: Third party tax registration number of the transaction.

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Third party tax registration ID of the transaction.

columns.name: MATCH_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of match for Payables transaction. Valid va;ues are purchase order, receipt, or consumption.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Transacation identifier of the source transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number of the source transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRX_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date of the source taxable transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPL_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Application short name associated with the source transaction.

columns.name: APP_TO_LINE_NUMBER

columns.name: APP_TO_APPL_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Application short name of the receipt that is applied to invoice.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TAXATION_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country for which the transaction is deemed to have taken place for taxation purposes.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Classification used by a tax authority to categorize a document associated with a transaction for a tax.

columns.name: FINAL_DISCHARGE_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Final destination location code for the purchases made by the customer.

columns.name: RETAINAGE_AMT
columns.description: Retainage amount for the item line.

columns.name: RETAINAGE_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Retainage percentage for the item line.

columns.name: TAX_GROSS_NET_FLAG
columns.description: Transaction tax calculated on the gross or net amount identifier.

columns.name: WHT_GROSS_NET_FLAG
columns.description: Withholding tax calculated on the gross or net amount identifier.
